Tether | Backend Engineer - Wallets | REMOTE (Worldwide) | Full-time | https://careers.tether.io/o/backend-engineer-wallets-100-rem...

Tether is hiring a Backend Engineer to build robust, scalable, and secure backend solutions for our digital token infrastructure and wallet services. You will work on groundbreaking, high-availability projects utilizing microservices and P2P technologies.

Requirements: Highly proficient in Node.js/JavaScript, microservices and databases (e.g. MongoDB). Strong security and scalability mindset.

Bonus: Blockchain integration skills, High-Availability systems, Redis.

Apply here: https://careers.tether.io/o/backend-engineer-wallets-100-rem... (Note: To avoid recruitment scams, please apply only through our official portal. We only communicate via @tether.to or @tether.io emails).
